name: cli-anything
description: Build, refine, test, validate, and inventory agent-native CLI harnesses for arbitrary software with the CLI-Anything 7-phase methodology (HKUDS/CLI-Anything port). Ships the authoritative HARNESS.md SOP, per-workflow command specs, deep-dive guides, and the runtime assets (repl_skin.py, preview_bundle.py, skill_generator.py) copied into every generated harness. Generated CLIs are pip-installable Click packages with REPL, --json output, and undo/redo that drive the real software backend — never a reimplementation.
